# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model: pretrained EfficientNet-B4 (noisy-student) backbone + custom
# dropout-regularized head. Whole-leaf diffuse texture/color symptoms match
# EfficientNet's strong ImageNet texture transfer at ~384px resolution.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_NAME = "tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k"  # smaller backbone: far lower activation memory under GPU contention


class CassavaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        drop_rate=0.3,
        drop_path_rate=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings only
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            model_name,
            pretrained=True,
            num_classes=0,
            global_pool="avg",
            drop_path_rate=drop_path_rate,  # stochastic depth regularization
        )
        if hasattr(self.backbone, "set_grad_checkpointing"):
            # trade compute for activation memory to survive GPU memory contention
            self.backbone.set_grad_checkpointing(enable=True)
        in_features = self.backbone.num_features
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate),
            nn.Linear(in_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate / 2),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.head(features)
        return logits


model = CassavaNet(model_name=BACKBONE_NAME, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, drop_rate=0.3)
model = model.to(device)
if device.type == "cuda":
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

num_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
num_trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
print(
    f"Model: {BACKBONE_NAME} | total params: {num_params:,} | trainable: {num_trainable:,}"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()


criterion = FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(
    alpha=class_weights, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optimizer: AdamW with differential learning rates — small LR for the
# pretrained backbone (preserve transferred texture filters), larger LR for
# the freshly-initialized head (needs to adapt quickly).
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_LR = 1e-4
HEAD_LR = 1e-3
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-2

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {"params": model.backbone.parameters(), "lr": BACKBONE_LR},
        {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": HEAD_LR},
    ],
    weight_decay=WEIGHT_DECAY,
)

print(
    f"Optimizer: AdamW | backbone_lr={BACKBONE_LR} head_lr={HEAD_LR} "
    f"weight_decay={WEIGHT_DECAY}"
)
print(
    f"Criterion: FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, alpha=class_weights)"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BATCH_SIZE = 4
GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS = 6  # effective batch size stays 24 while per-step memory drops to 1/6
NUM_EPOCHS = 12
EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE = 4
GRAD_CLIP_NORM = 5.0
BEST_MODEL_PATH = f"{WORKING_DIR}/best_model.pth"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DataLoaders (reuse Dataset objects from the data_processing step)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LR scheduler: cosine annealing over the full training run, re-using the
# differential-LR AdamW optimizer defined in the model_design step.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=NUM_EPOCHS, eta_min=1e-6)

use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
scaler = GradScaler(enabled=use_amp)


def run_train_epoch():
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    step = 0
    for step, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)

        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels) / GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    return total_loss / max(n_samples, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run_eval(loader):
    """Deterministic inference pass shared by validation scoring and test
    prediction, so both use IDENTICAL model.forward logic and post-processing
    (argmax over softmax logits)."""
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets_or_ids = []
    has_labels = loader.dataset.has_labels

    for images, targets in loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            if has_labels:
                labels = targets.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).detach().cpu().numpy()
        all_preds.append(preds)
        if has_labels:
            all_targets_or_ids.append(targets.numpy())
        else:
            all_targets_or_ids.extend(list(targets))

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_samples, 1) if has_labels else None
    if has_labels:
        all_targets_or_ids = np.concatenate(all_targets_or_ids)
    return all_preds, all_targets_or_ids, avg_loss


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on validation accuracy (official metric:
# classification accuracy, per task Evaluation section)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0

for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
    start_time = time.time()
    train_loss = run_train_epoch()
    val_preds, val_targets, val_loss = run_eval(val_loader)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)
    scheduler.step()
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch}/{NUM_EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
        f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} time={elapsed:.1f}s"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            break

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final scoring & inference
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=device))

val_preds, val_targets, _ = run_eval(val_loader)
score = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference — identical forward-pass / argmax post-processing as
# validation above, using the same deterministic eval_transform pipeline.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_preds, test_image_ids, _ = run_eval(test_loader)

pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"image_id": test_image_ids, "label": test_preds.astype(int)})

# Preserve the row order/coverage defined by the official sample submission.
submission_df = sample_sub_df[["image_id"]].merge(pred_df, on="image_id", how="left")
assert (
    submission_df["label"].isna().sum() == 0
), "Missing predictions for some test images"
submission_df["label"] = submission_df["label"].astype(int)

submission_path = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved submission to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        return image, row["image_id"]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()

            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)

                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        all_preds.append(preds)

    if has_labels:

class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        return image, row["image_id"]

# Model: pretrained EfficientNet-B4 (noisy-student) backbone + custom
# dropout-regularized head. Whole-leaf diffuse texture/color symptoms match
# EfficientNet's strong ImageNet texture transfer at ~384px resolution.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_NAME = "tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k"  # smaller backbone: far lower activation memory under GPU contention


class CassavaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        drop_rate=0.3,
        drop_path_rate=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings only
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            model_name,
            pretrained=True,
            num_classes=0,
            global_pool="avg",
            drop_path_rate=drop_path_rate,  # stochastic depth regularization
        )
        # Gradient checkpointing removed: b0 is tiny (4.6M params) and the
        # recompute overhead was the dominant cause of epochs exceeding the
        # 1h execution budget. Regular batch=16/accum=2 fits comfortably
        # without it.
        in_features = self.backbone.num_features
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate),
            nn.Linear(in_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate / 2),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.head(features)
        return logits

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()


criterion = FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(
    alpha=class_weights, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
)

# differential-LR AdamW optimizer defined in the model_design step.

use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
scaler = GradScaler(enabled=use_amp)


def run_train_epoch():
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    step = 0
    for step, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)

        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels) / GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    return total_loss / max(n_samples, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run_eval(loader):
    """Deterministic inference pass shared by validation scoring and test
    prediction, so both use IDENTICAL model.forward logic and post-processing
    (argmax over softmax logits)."""
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets_or_ids = []
    has_labels = loader.dataset.has_labels

    for images, targets in loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            if has_labels:
                labels = targets.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).detach().cpu().numpy()
        all_preds.append(preds)
        if has_labels:
            all_targets_or_ids.append(targets.numpy())
        else:
            all_targets_or_ids.extend(list(targets))

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_samples, 1) if has_labels else None
    if has_labels:
        all_targets_or_ids = np.concatenate(all_targets_or_ids)
    return all_preds, all_targets_or_ids, avg_loss


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on validation accuracy (official metric:
# classification accuracy, per task Evaluation section)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0
epoch_durations = []

for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
    if epoch_durations:
        avg_epoch_time = sum(epoch_durations) / len(epoch_durations)
        elapsed_so_far = time.time() - SCRIPT_START_TIME
        if elapsed_so_far + avg_epoch_time > TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS:
            print(
                f"Stopping training early to respect time budget: "
                f"elapsed={elapsed_so_far:.0f}s avg_epoch_time={avg_epoch_time:.0f}s "
                f"budget={TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS}s"
            )
            break

    start_time = time.time()
    train_loss = run_train_epoch()
    val_preds, val_targets, val_loss = run_eval(val_loader)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)
    scheduler.step()
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    epoch_durations.append(elapsed)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch}/{NUM_EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
        f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} time={elapsed:.1f}s"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            break

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final scoring & inference
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=device))

val_preds, val_targets, _ = run_eval(val_loader)
score = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference — identical forward-pass / argmax post-processing as
# validation above, using the same deterministic eval_transform pipeline.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_preds, test_image_ids, _ = run_eval(test_loader)

pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"image_id": test_image_ids, "label": test_preds.astype(int)})

# Preserve the row order/coverage defined by the official sample submission.

assert (
    submission_df["label"].isna().sum() == 0
), "Missing predictions for some test images"
submission_df["label"] = submission_df["label"].astype(int)

submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

    train_split_df["label"].value_counts().sort_index().values.astype(np.float64)
)
inv_freq = 1.0 / class_counts
class_weights = inv_freq / inv_freq.sum() * NUM_CLASSES
class_weights = torch.tensor(class_weights, dtype=torch.float32)
print(
    "Class weights (train split, inverse-frequency normalized):", class_weights.tolist()
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Augmentation pipelines (ImageNet normalization for downstream pretrained CNN)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IMAGENET_MEAN = (0.485, 0.456, 0.406)
IMAGENET_STD = (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)

train_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.RandomResizedCrop(
            size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), scale=(0.75, 1.0), ratio=(0.85, 1.15)
        ),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomAffine(degrees=25, translate=(0.06, 0.06), scale=(0.85, 1.15)),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.15, contrast=0.15, saturation=0.2, hue=12 / 255),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
        T.RandomErasing(p=0.4, scale=(0.02, 0.15), ratio=(0.3, 3.3)),
    ]
)

eval_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.Resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
    ]
)

# Val and test MUST share the exact same deterministic preprocessing.
val_transform = eval_transform
test_transform = eval_transform


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dataset
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        return image, row["image_id"]

    train_split_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, train_transform, has_labels=True
)
val_dataset = CassavaDataset(
    val_split_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, val_transform, has_labels=True
)
test_dataset = CassavaDataset(test_df, TEST_IMG_DIR, test_transform, has_labels=False)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model: pretrained EfficientNet-B4 (noisy-student) backbone + custom
# dropout-regularized head. Whole-leaf diffuse texture/color symptoms match
# EfficientNet's strong ImageNet texture transfer at ~384px resolution.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_NAME = "tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k"  # smaller backbone: far lower activation memory under GPU contention


class CassavaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        drop_rate=0.3,
        drop_path_rate=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings only
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            model_name,
            pretrained=True,
            num_classes=0,
            global_pool="avg",
            drop_path_rate=drop_path_rate,  # stochastic depth regularization
        )
        # Gradient checkpointing removed: b0 is tiny (4.6M params) and the
        # recompute overhead was the dominant cause of epochs exceeding the
        # 1h execution budget. Regular batch=16/accum=2 fits comfortably
        # without it.
        in_features = self.backbone.num_features
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate),
            nn.Linear(in_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate / 2),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.head(features)
        return logits


model = CassavaNet(model_name=BACKBONE_NAME, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, drop_rate=0.3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()


criterion = FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(
    alpha=class_weights, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
)

def run_train_epoch():
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    step = 0
    for step, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)

        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels) / GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    return total_loss / max(n_samples, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run_eval(loader):
    """Deterministic inference pass shared by validation scoring and test
    prediction, so both use IDENTICAL model.forward logic and post-processing
    (argmax over softmax logits)."""
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets_or_ids = []
    has_labels = loader.dataset.has_labels

    for images, targets in loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            if has_labels:
                labels = targets.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).detach().cpu().numpy()
        all_preds.append(preds)
        if has_labels:
            all_targets_or_ids.append(targets.numpy())
        else:
            all_targets_or_ids.extend(list(targets))

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_samples, 1) if has_labels else None
    if has_labels:
        all_targets_or_ids = np.concatenate(all_targets_or_ids)
    return all_preds, all_targets_or_ids, avg_loss


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on validation accuracy (official metric:
# classification accuracy, per task Evaluation section)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0
epoch_durations = []

for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
    if epoch_durations:
        avg_epoch_time = sum(epoch_durations) / len(epoch_durations)
        elapsed_so_far = time.time() - SCRIPT_START_TIME
        if elapsed_so_far + avg_epoch_time > TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS:
            print(
                f"Stopping training early to respect time budget: "
                f"elapsed={elapsed_so_far:.0f}s avg_epoch_time={avg_epoch_time:.0f}s "
                f"budget={TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS}s"
            )
            break

    start_time = time.time()
    train_loss = run_train_epoch()
    val_preds, val_targets, val_loss = run_eval(val_loader)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)
    scheduler.step()
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    epoch_durations.append(elapsed)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch}/{NUM_EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
        f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} time={elapsed:.1f}s"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            break

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final scoring & inference
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=device))

class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        return image, row["image_id"]

BACKBONE_NAME = "tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k"  # smaller backbone: far lower activation memory under GPU contention


class CassavaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        drop_rate=0.3,
        drop_path_rate=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings only
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            model_name,
            pretrained=True,
            num_classes=0,
            global_pool="avg",
            drop_path_rate=drop_path_rate,  # stochastic depth regularization
        )
        # Gradient checkpointing removed: b0 is tiny (4.6M params) and the
        # recompute overhead was the dominant cause of epochs exceeding the
        # 1h execution budget. Regular batch=16/accum=2 fits comfortably
        # without it.
        in_features = self.backbone.num_features
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate),
            nn.Linear(in_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate / 2),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.head(features)
        return logits

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()

    batch_size=EVAL_BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
    persistent_workers=True,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LR scheduler: cosine annealing over the full training run, re-using the
# differential-LR AdamW optimizer defined in the model_design step.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=NUM_EPOCHS, eta_min=1e-6)

use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
scaler = GradScaler(enabled=use_amp)


def run_train_epoch():
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    step = 0
    for step, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)

        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels) / GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    return total_loss / max(n_samples, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run_eval(loader):
    """Deterministic inference pass shared by validation scoring and test
    prediction, so both use IDENTICAL model.forward logic and post-processing
    (argmax over softmax logits)."""
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets_or_ids = []
    has_labels = loader.dataset.has_labels

    for images, targets in loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            if has_labels:
                labels = targets.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).detach().cpu().numpy()
        all_preds.append(preds)
        if has_labels:
            all_targets_or_ids.append(targets.numpy())
        else:
            all_targets_or_ids.extend(list(targets))

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_samples, 1) if has_labels else None
    if has_labels:
        all_targets_or_ids = np.concatenate(all_targets_or_ids)
    return all_preds, all_targets_or_ids, avg_loss


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on validation accuracy (official metric:
# classification accuracy, per task Evaluation section)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0
epoch_durations = []

for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
    if epoch_durations:
        avg_epoch_time = sum(epoch_durations) / len(epoch_durations)
        elapsed_so_far = time.time() - SCRIPT_START_TIME
        if elapsed_so_far + avg_epoch_time > TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS:
            print(
                f"Stopping training early to respect time budget: "
                f"elapsed={elapsed_so_far:.0f}s avg_epoch_time={avg_epoch_time:.0f}s "
                f"budget={TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS}s"
            )
            break

    start_time = time.time()
    train_loss = run_train_epoch()
    val_preds, val_targets, val_loss = run_eval(val_loader)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)
    scheduler.step()
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    epoch_durations.append(elapsed)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch}/{NUM_EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
        f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} time={elapsed:.1f}s"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            break

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final scoring & inference
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=device))

val_preds, val_targets, _ = run_eval(val_loader)
score = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference — identical forward-pass / argmax post-processing as
# validation above, using the same deterministic eval_transform pipeline.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_preds, test_image_ids, _ = run_eval(test_loader)

pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"image_id": test_image_ids, "label": test_preds.astype(int)})

# Preserve the row order/coverage defined by the official sample submission.
submission_df = sample_sub_df[["image_id"]].merge(pred_df, on="image_id", how="left")
assert (
    submission_df["label"].isna().sum() == 0
), "Missing predictions for some test images"
submission_df["label"] = submission_df["label"].astype(int)

submission_path = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved submission to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

import os
import json
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader, WeightedRandomSampler
import torchvision.transforms as T
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.utils.class_weight import compute_class_weight
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import timm
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts

# ==================================================================
# STEP 1: Data processing & feature engineering
# ==================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
TRAIN_IMG_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train_images")
TEST_IMG_DIR = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test_images")
TRAIN_CSV = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_CSV = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
LABEL_MAP_JSON = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "label_num_to_disease_map.json")

SEED = 42
IMAGE_SIZE = 224
NUM_CLASSES = 5
TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS = 2400  # hard cap on training wall-clock so eval/test/submission steps always run within the 1h execution limit

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load raw data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df_full = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_CSV)
train_df_full = train_df_full.drop_duplicates(subset="image_id").reset_index(drop=True)

with open(LABEL_MAP_JSON, "r") as f:
    label_num_to_disease_map = json.load(f)

sample_sub_df = pd.read_csv(
    SAMPLE_SUB_CSV
)  # authoritative row order/columns for submission

# Sanity-clean: keep only rows whose image file actually exists on disk
existing_mask = train_df_full["image_id"].apply(
    lambda x: os.path.isfile(os.path.join(TRAIN_IMG_DIR, x))
)
train_df_full = train_df_full[existing_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stratified train/validation split (split FIRST, before any stateful fitting)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
    train_df_full,
    test_size=0.1,
    stratify=train_df_full["label"],
    random_state=SEED,
)
train_df = train_df.reset_index(drop=True)
val_df = val_df.reset_index(drop=True)

print(
    "Class distribution (full):",
    train_df_full["label"].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index().round(4).to_dict(),
)
print(
    "Class distribution (train split):",
    train_df["label"].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index().round(4).to_dict(),
)
print(
    "Class distribution (val split):",
    val_df["label"].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index().round(4).to_dict(),
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Class weights / sample weights — computed ONLY from the training split
# to counter CMD-dominant / CBB-rare imbalance
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class_weights_array = compute_class_weight(
    class_weight="balanced",
    classes=np.arange(NUM_CLASSES),
    y=train_df["label"].values,
)
class_weights = torch.tensor(class_weights_array, dtype=torch.float32)

label_to_weight = {i: class_weights_array[i] for i in range(NUM_CLASSES)}
train_sample_weights = train_df["label"].map(label_to_weight).values.astype(np.float32)
train_sample_weights = torch.tensor(train_sample_weights, dtype=torch.float32)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test set — built strictly from sample_submission.csv to guarantee
# identical row order/coverage as required for the final submission
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_df = sample_sub_df[["image_id"]].copy()
test_exists_mask = test_df["image_id"].apply(
    lambda x: os.path.isfile(os.path.join(TEST_IMG_DIR, x))
)
assert (
    test_exists_mask.all()
), "Some test images referenced in sample_submission.csv are missing on disk."

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transforms (feature engineering for image modality)
# ImageNet normalization stats used because downstream model will be a
# transfer-learning CNN/ViT backbone pretrained on ImageNet.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
IMAGENET_MEAN = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
IMAGENET_STD = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]

train_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.RandomResizedCrop(IMAGE_SIZE, scale=(0.75, 1.0), ratio=(0.9, 1.1)),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5),  # leaves have no canonical up/down orientation
        T.RandomRotation(degrees=25),  # leaf orientation in field photos is arbitrary
        T.ColorJitter(
            brightness=0.25, contrast=0.25, saturation=0.25, hue=0.05
        ),  # field lighting variance
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
        T.RandomErasing(
            p=0.25, scale=(0.02, 0.12)
        ),  # simulates occlusion/background clutter
    ]
)

eval_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.Resize((IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_SIZE)),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
    ]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dataset classes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        else:
            return image, row["image_id"]


train_dataset = CassavaDataset(
    train_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, train_transform, has_labels=True
)
val_dataset = CassavaDataset(val_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, eval_transform, has_labels=True)
test_dataset = CassavaDataset(test_df, TEST_IMG_DIR, eval_transform, has_labels=False)

print(
    f"Train samples: {len(train_dataset)} | Val samples: {len(val_dataset)} | Test samples: {len(test_dataset)}"
)
print(f"Class weights (balanced, from train split only): {class_weights.tolist()}")

# ==================================================================
# STEP 2: Model design
# ==================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Device
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model: ViT backbone (global self-attention over the whole leaf,
# complementary inductive bias to pure-CNN local-texture extractors)
# + small regularized MLP head for the 5-way classification target.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_NAME = "vit_small_patch16_224"
MODEL_NUM_CLASSES = 5
DROPOUT_RATE = 0.3


class CassavaViTClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        backbone_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=MODEL_NUM_CLASSES,
        dropout_rate=DROPOUT_RATE,
        pretrained=True,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            backbone_name, pretrained=pretrained, num_classes=0
        )
        feat_dim = self.backbone.num_features

        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(p=dropout_rate)
        self.hidden = nn.Linear(feat_dim, 512)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(512)
        self.act = nn.GELU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(p=dropout_rate * 0.5)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(512, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        feats = self.backbone(x)
        x = self.dropout1(feats)
        x = self.hidden(x)
        x = self.bn(x)
        x = self.act(x)
        x = self.dropout2(x)
        logits = self.classifier(x)  # raw logits, argmax -> predicted integer label
        return logits


model = CassavaViTClassifier().to(DEVICE)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: Focal Loss (down-weights easy majority-class CMD samples)
# combined with inverse-frequency class_weights (from data step, to
# counter CBB-rare/CMD-dominant imbalance) and label smoothing
# (this dataset is known to contain noisy/mislabeled samples).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithClassWeights(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, class_weights=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.05, num_classes=5
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        if class_weights is None:
            class_weights = torch.ones(num_classes)
        self.register_buffer("class_weights", class_weights.clone().detach().float())

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        pt = (
            (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1e-7)
        )  # smoothed "confidence" in true class
        focal_term = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        sample_weights = self.class_weights[targets]
        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)

        loss = focal_term * sample_weights * ce
        return loss.mean()


# `class_weights` is produced by the data_processing step (balanced,
# computed from the train split only) — reused here unmodified.
criterion = FocalLossWithClassWeights(
    class_weights=class_weights,
    gamma=2.0,
    label_smoothing=0.05,
    num_classes=MODEL_NUM_CLASSES,
).to(DEVICE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optimizer: differential learning rates — small LR for the pretrained
# ViT backbone (preserve transferred representations), larger LR for
# the freshly-initialized head (needs to adapt quickly).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
backbone_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
head_params = (
    list(model.hidden.parameters())
    + list(model.bn.parameters())
    + list(model.classifier.parameters())
)

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {"params": backbone_params, "lr": 1e-5},
        {"params": head_params, "lr": 1e-3},
    ],
    weight_decay=1e-2,
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# LR scheduler: cosine annealing with warm restarts for smoother
# convergence and escape from sharp minima across epochs.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=5, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6)

print(f"Model: {BACKBONE_NAME} | Backbone feature dim: {model.backbone.num_features}")
print(f"Device: {DEVICE}")
print(
    f"Trainable params: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad):,}"
)

# ==================================================================
# STEP 3: Training & evaluation
# ==================================================================

BATCH_SIZE = 64
NUM_EPOCHS = 6
EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE = 3
GRAD_CLIP_NORM = 1.0
BEST_MODEL_PATH = "./working/best_model.pth"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# DataLoaders. Training uses a WeightedRandomSampler built from the
# inverse-frequency `train_sample_weights` computed in the data step,
# so CBB (rare) is oversampled relative to CMD (dominant) each epoch.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
train_sampler = WeightedRandomSampler(
    weights=train_sample_weights,
    num_samples=len(train_sample_weights),
    replacement=True,
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    sampler=train_sampler,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)

scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=(DEVICE.type == "cuda"))


def run_validation(eval_model, loader):
    eval_model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_targets = []
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_batches = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, labels in loader:
            images = images.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            labels = labels.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=(DEVICE.type == "cuda")):
                logits = eval_model(images)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            total_loss += loss.item()
            n_batches += 1
            preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(preds.cpu().numpy())
            all_targets.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    all_targets = np.concatenate(all_targets)
    # Official metric: classification accuracy = fraction of exact label matches
    acc = accuracy_score(all_targets, all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_batches, 1)
    return acc, avg_loss


best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0
training_start_time = time.time()

for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    running_loss = 0.0
    n_train_batches = 0
    for images, labels in train_loader:
        images = images.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=(DEVICE.type == "cuda")):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

        running_loss += loss.item()
        n_train_batches += 1

    scheduler.step()

    train_loss = running_loss / max(n_train_batches, 1)
    val_acc, val_loss = run_validation(model, val_loader)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{NUM_EPOCHS} - train_loss: {train_loss:.4f} - "
        f"val_loss: {val_loss:.4f} - val_acc: {val_acc:.4f}"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    elapsed = time.time() - training_start_time
    if elapsed > TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS:
        print(f"Time budget exceeded ({elapsed:.0f}s > {TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS}s) - stopping training after epoch {epoch+1} to leave time for eval/test/submission")
        break

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reload best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final evaluation
# and test inference — same model used for both, same eval pipeline.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=DEVICE))
model.to(DEVICE)
model.eval()

final_val_acc, _ = run_validation(model, val_loader)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference — identical forward-pass / preprocessing pipeline as
# validation (same eval_transform via test_dataset, same model.eval()).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
test_image_ids = []
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for images, image_ids in test_loader:
        images = images.to(DEVICE, non_blocking=True)
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=(DEVICE.type == "cuda")):
            logits = model(images)
        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        test_preds.extend(preds.tolist())
        test_image_ids.extend(list(image_ids))

test_pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"image_id": test_image_ids, "label": test_preds})

# Strictly align to sample_submission.csv row order/coverage
submission_df = sample_sub_df[["image_id"]].merge(
    test_pred_df, on="image_id", how="left"
)
assert (
    submission_df["label"].isna().sum() == 0
), "Missing predictions for some test image_ids"
submission_df["label"] = submission_df["label"].astype(int)

submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

score = final_val_acc
print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")

# Build test dataframe from the actual test_images directory to guarantee full,

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    train_df,
    test_size=0.15,
    stratify=train_df["label"],
    random_state=SEED,
)

val_split_df = val_split_df.reset_index(drop=True)

print("Val split label distribution:")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Class weights (train split only) for imbalance-aware loss in training step
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class_counts = (
    train_split_df["label"].value_counts().sort_index().values.astype(np.float64)
)
inv_freq = 1.0 / class_counts
class_weights = inv_freq / inv_freq.sum() * NUM_CLASSES
class_weights = torch.tensor(class_weights, dtype=torch.float32)
print(
    "Class weights (train split, inverse-frequency normalized):", class_weights.tolist()
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Augmentation pipelines (ImageNet normalization for downstream pretrained CNN)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IMAGENET_MEAN = (0.485, 0.456, 0.406)
IMAGENET_STD = (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)

train_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.RandomResizedCrop(
            size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE), scale=(0.75, 1.0), ratio=(0.85, 1.15)
        ),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomVerticalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomAffine(degrees=25, translate=(0.06, 0.06), scale=(0.85, 1.15)),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.15, contrast=0.15, saturation=0.2, hue=12 / 255),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
        T.RandomErasing(p=0.4, scale=(0.02, 0.15), ratio=(0.3, 3.3)),
    ]
)

eval_transform = T.Compose(
    [
        T.Resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)),
        T.ToTensor(),
        T.Normalize(mean=IMAGENET_MEAN, std=IMAGENET_STD),
    ]
)

# Val and test MUST share the exact same deterministic preprocessing.
val_transform = eval_transform
test_transform = eval_transform


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dataset
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CassavaDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform, has_labels=True):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_labels = has_labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["image_id"])
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = self.transform(image)

        if self.has_labels:
            label = int(row["label"])
            return image, label
        return image, row["image_id"]

    train_split_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, train_transform, has_labels=True
)
val_dataset = CassavaDataset(
    val_split_df, TRAIN_IMG_DIR, val_transform, has_labels=True
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model: pretrained EfficientNet-B4 (noisy-student) backbone + custom
# dropout-regularized head. Whole-leaf diffuse texture/color symptoms match
# EfficientNet's strong ImageNet texture transfer at ~384px resolution.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BACKBONE_NAME = "tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k"  # smaller backbone: far lower activation memory under GPU contention


class CassavaNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=BACKBONE_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_CLASSES,
        drop_rate=0.3,
        drop_path_rate=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        # num_classes=0 -> backbone returns pooled feature embeddings only
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            model_name,
            pretrained=True,
            num_classes=0,
            global_pool="avg",
            drop_path_rate=drop_path_rate,  # stochastic depth regularization
        )
        # Gradient checkpointing removed: b0 is tiny (4.6M params) and the
        # recompute overhead was the dominant cause of epochs exceeding the
        # 1h execution budget. Regular batch=16/accum=2 fits comfortably
        # without it.
        in_features = self.backbone.num_features
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate),
            nn.Linear(in_features, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.SiLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Dropout(p=drop_rate / 2),
            nn.Linear(512, num_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.backbone(x)
        logits = self.head(features)
        return logits


model = CassavaNet(model_name=BACKBONE_NAME, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES, drop_rate=0.3)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Loss: class-weighted Focal Loss + label smoothing.
#   - alpha (class_weights from data step) explicitly corrects the ~12:1
#     CMD:CBB imbalance.
#   - focal term (gamma) further down-weights easy, already-confident
#     majority-class predictions so gradient stays focused on hard/minority
#     examples.
#   - label smoothing guards against the known label noise in this dataset
#     (crowdsourced disease annotations), preventing overconfident fitting
#     to mislabeled samples.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.label_smoothing = label_smoothing
        self.num_classes = num_classes

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        probs = log_probs.exp()

        with torch.no_grad():
            true_dist = torch.full_like(
                log_probs, self.label_smoothing / (self.num_classes - 1)
            )
            true_dist.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.label_smoothing)

        # confidence of the (smoothed) true class -> focal modulation factor
        pt = (probs * true_dist).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-7, max=1.0)
        focal_factor = (1.0 - pt) ** self.gamma

        ce = -(true_dist * log_probs).sum(dim=1)
        loss = focal_factor * ce

        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.to(logits.device)[targets]
            loss = alpha_t * loss

        return loss.mean()


criterion = FocalLossWithLabelSmoothing(
    alpha=class_weights, gamma=2.0, label_smoothing=0.1, num_classes=NUM_CLASSES
)

)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LR scheduler: cosine annealing over the full training run, re-using the
# differential-LR AdamW optimizer defined in the model_design step.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=NUM_EPOCHS, eta_min=1e-6)

use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
scaler = GradScaler(enabled=use_amp)


def run_train_epoch():
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    step = 0
    for step, (images, labels) in enumerate(train_loader):
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        labels = labels.to(device, non_blocking=True)

        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels) / GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()

        if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

        batch_size = labels.size(0)
        total_loss += loss.item() * GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS * batch_size
        n_samples += batch_size

    if (step + 1) % GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS != 0:
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), GRAD_CLIP_NORM)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    return total_loss / max(n_samples, 1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run_eval(loader):
    """Deterministic inference pass shared by validation scoring and test
    prediction, so both use IDENTICAL model.forward logic and post-processing
    (argmax over softmax logits)."""
    model.eval()
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_samples = 0
    all_preds = []
    all_targets_or_ids = []
    has_labels = loader.dataset.has_labels

    for images, targets in loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        with autocast(device_type=device.type, enabled=use_amp):
            logits = model(images)
            if has_labels:
                labels = targets.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                n_samples += labels.size(0)

        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).detach().cpu().numpy()
        all_preds.append(preds)
        if has_labels:
            all_targets_or_ids.append(targets.numpy())
        else:
            all_targets_or_ids.extend(list(targets))

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    avg_loss = total_loss / max(n_samples, 1) if has_labels else None
    if has_labels:
        all_targets_or_ids = np.concatenate(all_targets_or_ids)
    return all_preds, all_targets_or_ids, avg_loss


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Training loop with early stopping on validation accuracy (official metric:
# classification accuracy, per task Evaluation section)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
best_val_acc = -1.0
epochs_without_improvement = 0
epoch_durations = []

for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
    if epoch_durations:
        avg_epoch_time = sum(epoch_durations) / len(epoch_durations)
        elapsed_so_far = time.time() - SCRIPT_START_TIME
        if elapsed_so_far + avg_epoch_time > TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS:
            print(
                f"Stopping training early to respect time budget: "
                f"elapsed={elapsed_so_far:.0f}s avg_epoch_time={avg_epoch_time:.0f}s "
                f"budget={TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS}s"
            )
            break

    start_time = time.time()
    train_loss = run_train_epoch()
    val_preds, val_targets, val_loss = run_eval(val_loader)
    val_acc = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)
    scheduler.step()
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    epoch_durations.append(elapsed)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch}/{NUM_EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
        f"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} val_acc={val_acc:.4f} time={elapsed:.1f}s"
    )

    if val_acc > best_val_acc:
        best_val_acc = val_acc
        epochs_without_improvement = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL_PATH)
    else:
        epochs_without_improvement += 1
        if epochs_without_improvement >= EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE:
            break

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load best checkpoint (by validation accuracy) for final scoring & inference
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model.load_state_dict(torch.load(BEST_MODEL_PATH, map_location=device))

val_preds, val_targets, _ = run_eval(val_loader)
score = accuracy_score(val_targets, val_preds)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test inference — identical forward-pass / argmax post-processing as
# validation above, using the same deterministic eval_transform pipeline.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_preds, test_image_ids, _ = run_eval(test_loader)

pred_df = pd.DataFrame({"image_id": test_image_ids, "label": test_preds.astype(int)})

# Preserve the row order/coverage defined by the official sample submission.
submission_df = sample_sub_df[["image_id"]].merge(pred_df, on="image_id", how="left")
assert (
    submission_df["label"].isna().sum() == 0
), "Missing predictions for some test images"
submission_df["label"] = submission_df["label"].astype(int)

submission_path = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved submission to {submission_path} with shape {submission_df.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {score}")
